title: Jonathan Blow on scripting languages
summary: A 10-minute clip from a Jonathan Blow Twitch stream in which he argues that game engines do not really need separate scripting languages. He questions the value of embedded interpreters when the main language can do the job.
why: Cited in threads about Lua, embedded scripting, and game engines as a concise argument that scripting languages are redundant.

quote.text: Jonathan Blow has a great talk on the redundancy of scripting languages in game engines.
